decisions.reason: As a very recently launched product that builds on the firm’s core wafer-processing capabilities and fits its stated move toward more complex semiconductor substrates, management would likely continue it because investment and public commitment are already in place and there is no clear evidence of failure.

Management would likely retain this newly launched carrier wafer because it is closely tied to the firm’s announced strategic direction in handling and packaging wafers, was explicitly publicized on the website, and any early market weakness could still be seen as temporary in a growing industry.
